features.description: Native scalar machine instructions for proven typed scalar paths.
Native vector instruction lowering for proven vectorizable kernels.
Native threading and atomics under platform/runtime support.
BLAS symbol closure through provider libraries or source-recompiled target custody.
LAPACK symbol closure through provider libraries or source-recompiled target custody.
GSL symbol closure with explicit license and per-target source/artifact custody.
One dtype/shape/stride/offset/owner/device storage identity projected into target APIs.
Baseline WebAssembly core module support.
Multi-value returns for small tuple/error-value internal ABI results.
Tail-call proposal lowering for tail-position control flow.
WASM exception handling for Python unwind traffic.
64-bit linear-memory and table indexes for large-memory profiles.
Shared-memory threading support.
WASM atomics for shared-memory profiles.
Deterministic v128 SIMD lane for numeric kernels.
Relaxed SIMD speed tier; not allowed in bit-exact parity lanes.
Flexible vector proposal tracking.
Half-precision proposal tracking.
Wide arithmetic proposal tracking for int/hash/crypto lowering.
WasmGC closed-layout object profile.
Reference types used with GC/object-layout profiles.
JS Promise Integration for naturally async browser host calls.
WASI preview1 style host interface for current wasm-server lanes.
Component Model/WIT interface authority.
WASI 0.3 async func, stream, and future primitives.
Browser WebGPU API availability through navigator.gpu and adapter/device probes.
WGSL storage-buffer compute pipeline support.
WGSL workgroup memory support.
WebGPU/WGSL atomic operation support.
WebGPU shader-f16 feature.
WebGPU subgroup operation support.
Timestamp query observability; never a semantic fact.
WebNN graph execution for admitted inference subgraphs.
